description: Query hemnet.se (Swedish property portal) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the hemnet-mcp server — resolve locations, search for-sale and sold listings, and read listing detail via one-shot GraphQL calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want Hemnet data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
